characterDescription: Compact terminal navigation — 48px height, IBM Plex Mono 0.75rem uppercase with 0.1em tracking. Transparent background with magenta-pink bottom border (opacity 0.4 → 0.8 on scroll) acting as a neon indicator line. Scrolled state adds a near-opaque dark background and intensified magenta glow. Link hover triggers magenta drawn-in underline at 0.15s mechanical snap. No backdrop blur — pure digital dark field.
